SipChip is a device that can detect for date rape drugs and other foreign chemicals in your beverage in 30 seconds! Attach SipChip to your phone, keychain or wallet so you are prepared on the go! #MeToo #GenderEquality #Detection @ItsOnUs @RAINN

While the #MeToo Movement has gotten us to talk about how we can prevent sexual violence, it often stops there, and other aspects of sexual violence are not talked about. The connection between sexual violence and eating disorders is one of them. 
https://t.co/vLcl80VnMi

1 in 3 women will experience some form of sexual violence in their lives. Many women live in hyperalertness, always afraid of repeat trauma. Sexual abuse is so common, we encourage those to seek support resources like @RAINN.  #MeToo #StandWithSurvivors
https://t.co/QPCjHV5F6g

Before the #MeToo movement, artists took to the streets to bring awareness about rape and redefine it. The acts of these brave women gained media attention at the time, and worked to help survivors begin their healing process #WomensHistoryMonth 
https://t.co/voBYr4uupa

The “Surviving R. Kelly” documentary has had a massive impact across the board, and it helped Ethiopia create their own #MeToo movement. #MeTooEthiopia helps Ethiopian survivors feel safe to speak about assault in a culture that has normalized the act 
https://t.co/P6o2afY9uG

In this article from @TheRoot #MeToo founder Tarana Burke speaks about how differently sexual violence impacts black people. This sexual assault awareness month, let’s begin to recognize that difference and work to help everyone #SAAM #ItsOnUs
https://t.co/k9cjryBHr8

Nuns who speak out about their sexual assault experiences are being blamed by male church leaders. These male religious leaders convince the women that they are at fault for 'seducing' the priest, or bishop. Stop #VictimBlaming #NunsToo #MeToo 
https://t.co/QluZVW8Itn

While #MeToo was a catalyst to out “high profile abusers” Tarana Burke warns that is not a solution to end sexual violence. The movement is “a global community of survivors who are committed to healing and action,” and there is still work to be done #SAAM
https://t.co/TQvlNkQpGr

Measuring #MeToo, was just released that looks at the characteristics of sexual violence in America. By looking at the prevalence of sexual violence in different communities, this study gives us more ways to prevent sexual violence #PreventionisPossible
https://t.co/19t1IPtuSi

We have seen the impact of the #MeToo movement, but some people may still have a hard time understanding its implications.  @parul_sehgal  gives us several books to read to better understand the essence of the movement and survivors may go through
